decisions.reason: It remains close to the firm's core second-channel authentication and secure communication offering, although after several years it could be folded into broader platform solutions rather than withdrawn outright.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is still strategically central for a German security specialist with strong R&D and cryptography capabilities, making continued support more likely than exit.
The QR-code-based hardware token fits less well with the firm's move toward app-based, cross-channel identity ecosystems and adds hardware complexity that is increasingly hard to justify.

The payment network security compliance suite still serves regulated enterprise demand and leverages the firm's established security infrastructure, even if it is more niche than the core identity platform.
